blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some internet service providers (IPS) across the country were having network issues and internet outages on Friday evening, October 2. The University of the Philippines Diliman Network Helpdesk reported that one of the undersea cable segments between the Philippines and Singapore is reportedly offline.
